criticism: Allows owner to manipulate balances arbitrarily.
Similar to burn, allows potential abuse.
Allows owner to selfdestruct contract and steal funds, highly dangerous.
The function allows the owner to mint tokens without any checks, which can lead to an overflow of the total supply, potentially freezing funds or causing other critical issues.
The function does not check the return value of the call to the spender, which can lead to unexpected behavior if the call fails.
